answer.generated: Configuration management ensures that changes to software are tracked and controlled, especially during system building when multiple team members contribute. It includes planning, version management, and change management to maintain consistency across system components. Without proper configuration management, errors and inconsistencies can arise, making it essential for large-scale team development.
